remediated_title: The 1983 Soviet Glitch: The Midnight World War 3 Almost Began
remediated_description:
On September 26, 1983, inside Serpukhov-15, Soviet early-warning computers flashed: 'LAUNCH'. Five American nuclear missiles were reported inbound. One man, Stanislav Petrov, had 20 minutes to decide whether to trigger World War III.

🏛️ HISTORICAL ARCHIVAL RECREATION: This documentary incorporates educational historical simulations and procedural synthetic visuals strictly for historical education, academic research, and archival reenactment under Fair Use guidelines.
